name: Chevening Scholarship
notes: Needs about 2 years of work experience plus leadership and networking essays.

name: Commonwealth Scholarship (Masters/PhD)
notes: Applied through nominating bodies; strong development-impact story required.

name: DAAD (HEC-DAAD) Scholarship
notes: Research fit and a clear motivation letter matter a lot.

name: Fulbright Pakistan Scholarship
typical_deadline: Usually autumn; check the Fulbright Pakistan site
notes: Often requires GRE or TOEFL per program; check current rules.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
notes: Applied through HEC; accessible and popular with Pakistani students.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
notes: Needs a professor acceptance letter for many routes; English-taught options available.

name: MEXT Scholarship
typical_deadline: Around April to May via embassy
notes: Research plan quality is critical; age limits apply.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
notes: Each program sets its own rules; apply to several.

name: Turkiye Burslari
notes: Fully funded; academic grades are weighted heavily.
